question: 5 stones were dropped from the top of a building. They all fell to the ground in straight lines. What can be said about their motion?
solution:
The correct answer is __**They had rectilinear motion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rectilinear motion** is a type of motion where an object moves along a straight line.
 
• When the stones were dropped from the top of the building, they moved under the influence of **gravity** in a straight line towards the ground.
 
• This type of motion is also referred to as **linear motion** because the path taken by the object is a straight line.
 
• In the absence of any other forces acting in different directions, the stones would follow a straight path due to the constant acceleration provided by gravity.
 
• The motion of the stones can be described using the equations of **uniformly accelerated motion**, where the only acceleration is due to gravity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Curvilinear motion**__

 __
 
• Curvilinear motion refers to motion along a curved path.
 
• This type of motion is not applicable in this scenario because the stones fell straight down, not along a curved trajectory.
 
 
 
• **Slow motion**__
 __
 
• Slow motion is a term used to describe the speed of an object.
 
• It does not describe the nature of the path taken by the stones.
 
 
 
• **Gravity free motion**__
 
 
• Gravity free motion implies the absence of gravitational force.
 
• This is not applicable here, as the stones were influenced by gravity when they fell to the ground.
